description.value: Canada's first purpose-built gastro brewpub, Spinnakers has been crafting its own ales and pairing them with farm-to-table cuisine since 1984, drawing on partnerships with over 35 local Vancouver Island producers. Perched on Victoria's Vic West waterfront with views of the Inner Harbour, the site combines a full-service restaurant, taproom, provisions store with growler fills, and heritage guesthouses in a single destination. Cyclists can linger over a range of house-brewed craft beers and seasonal pub fare on a covered heated patio.
